title: Rational algebraic integers are integers
statement:
Let $\Omega$ be a field of characteristic $0$, with the canonical inclusions $\mathbf Z\hookrightarrow\mathbf Q\hookrightarrow\Omega$. If $x\in\Omega$ is an algebraic integer [def-weil-algebraic-integer], then
$$
(\exists r\in\mathbf Q,\ x=r)\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad(\exists n\in\mathbf Z,\ x=n),
$$
where both equalities are in $\Omega$.
